messages.content: "請問您能否提供我過去5年微軟每季的歷史股息資料，然後再提供同樣的資料但是以年為單位？之後，能否幫我取得微軟過去60天和過去120天的股市資料？"

function.name: corporate_finance_dividend_data
function.description: Get historical dividend data of a specific company within a particular duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the dividend data for.

years.description: Number of past years for which to retrieve the data.

frequency.description: The frequency of the dividend payment.

function.name: stock_market_data
function.description: Retrieve stock market data for a specific company and time frame. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company that you want to get the stock market data for.

days.description: Number of past days for which to retrieve the data.
